bio.text: Joel Anabilah-Azumah is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York's 9th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia says he was born in New York City, graduated from Trinity School, earned a bachelor's degree from Union College in 2005, and has worked in transportation.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a small business owner.
